panels.clean_Japanese:
ちょっとお聞きになりました？
王女様がご婚約なさるんですって
panels.english: {SPEAKER:A6}Did you hear? The princess is getting engaged!
panels.original_localization_note: She asks if her companion heard that the princess is getting engaged. Keep the excited opening and the complete announcement.

panels.clean_Japanese:
ええ、お相手は公爵様の
ご子息ですって？
panels.original_localization_note: She has heard and asks whether the match is the duke’s son. Give her a natural confirmation tag.

panels.clean_Japanese:
婚約指輪は
山ひとつ買えるほどのお値段だとか
panels.english: {SPEAKER:A6}I hear the ring costs enough to buy a mountain.
panels.original_localization_note: She reports the ring supposedly costs enough to buy a whole mountain. Keep the hearsay and comic scale.

panels.clean_Japanese:
さすがは公爵様ですわね…
王女様がその宝石をお着けになった
お姿を拝見できるのは
いつでございましょうね？
panels.english: {SPEAKER:A7}You'd expect as much from a duke. When will we see her wearing it?
panels.original_localization_note: She admires what she expects of a duke and wonders when they can see the princess wearing the jewel. Keep the social admiration and anticipation.

panels.clean_Japanese:
そう遠いことではございませんわよ
そうなったら、その宝石を求める
婦人が増えますわね、きっと
panels.english: {SPEAKER:A6}It won't be long. Once she wears it, imagine how many ladies will want one!
panels.original_localization_note: She expects it before long and predicts other ladies will want the jewel. Keep the time, prediction, and qualified number of people.

panels.clean_Japanese:
まあ！　流行してからでは遅いですわ！
何なのかしら、その宝石？
あなた、ご存じ？
panels.english: {SPEAKER:A7}Oh! Once it's in fashion, it'll be too late! Do you know which gem it is?
panels.original_localization_note: She says it will be too late once the jewel is fashionable and asks which gem it is. Keep the rush and direct question.

panels.clean_Japanese:
存じませんわ
さっそく聞きにいかなくては！
panels.original_localization_note: She does not know and says they should ask immediately. Keep the moment of decision.

panels.clean_Japanese: ロンドンで宝石が流行しそうです
panels.english: {SYSTEM}Gemstones may soon be all the rage in London.
panels.original_localization_note: The notice forecasts a trend for gems in London. Keep the broad category because the characters have not identified the gem.

panels.clean_Japanese:
あの真っ赤なルビー
ご覧になりました？
panels.english: {SPEAKER:A6}Did you see that brilliant red ruby?
panels.original_localization_note: She asks if the others saw the vividly red ruby. Keep her eager attention to its color.

panels.clean_Japanese: ええ、素晴らしかったですわ
panels.original_localization_note: She answers that it was magnificent. Keep the clipped admiration.

panels.english: {SPEAKER:A8}Oh? What are you two talking about?
panels.original_localization_note: The third woman asks what they mean. Keep her polite interruption as the conversation opens to her.

panels.clean_Japanese:
例の御婦人の着けていたネックレスの
ことですわ
panels.original_localization_note: She identifies the necklace the lady was wearing. Keep the reference to an unnamed woman and her necklace.

panels.clean_Japanese:
ああ、あの
大きくて美しい石でしたこと
panels.original_localization_note: The third woman remembers the big, beautiful stone. Keep her recognition and both qualities.

panels.clean_Japanese:
一生に一度でいいから
殿方からあのような贈り物を
頂戴したいものですこと
panels.english: {SPEAKER:A7}I'd love a man to give me a gift like that. Just once in my life.
panels.original_localization_note: She wishes a gentleman would give her such a gift just once in her life. Keep the existing longing and wrap the comparison together.
She agrees and sighs. Keep the sigh as the first in a three-part comic chorus.
She sighs too. Keep the silent reaction as a short printed sound cue.
She joins the other two with a sigh. Keep the matching third beat.

panels.clean_Japanese:
アテネでルビーが
流行しそうです
panels.english: {SYSTEM}Rubies may soon be all the rage in Athens.
panels.original_localization_note: The notice forecasts a ruby trend in Athens. Keep the gem, town, and tentative outcome.
